books.title: The Way
books.author: St Josemaría Escrivá
books.description: St Josemaría Escrivá's first collection of short points for meditation and prayer, 999 in all.
books.evidence: The brief names The Way as a Scepter UK title, but every listing seen (Amazon UK 1889334421, 222 pp, Scepter Pubs 2002; Mini Edition 0933932545; 1979 edition 0933932014; Kindle B004AM5NVA) is a Scepter Publishers (US) edition. No 978-0-906138 ISBN or scepter.uk page was seen. The WebSearch budget for this session was used up (200/200) before this pass could re-verify, so the verdict rests on the earlier sweep only. The count of 999 is 3,054 (one-volume total) minus 1,000 (Furrow) minus 1,055 (The Forge).
